verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an in-dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows that assistant, or any other part of Supabase, acting as an MCP client. The MCP evidence covers the server role only: Supabase's own MCP server for external agents and hosting your own MCP servers on Edge Functions. Neither shows Supabase plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, so neither can be credited here.
